description: Validate raw JSON and return it pretty-printed or minified. `pretty` (default true) uses two-space indentation; false minifies. `sort_keys` (default false) sorts object keys alphabetically and leaves array order alone. Input is capped at 1 MB. Invalid JSON raises with the line and column and is not charged. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base), no account or API key.
name: format_json
